title: Act 1 - Segment 3: Vermilion City to Route 2 (Thunder Badge)
vanilla_divergence_alerts: HM Slaves: 100% eliminated by 9 reusable Key Item tools. Do NOT instruct players to teach field moves to party members.
Friendship: Eliminated. All friendship evolutions use static level thresholds (e.g. Baby Pokémon evolve at Lv. 15).
Trade Evolutions: Evolve naturally at Level 40 OR via Linking Cord (not Level 37).
S.S. ANNE DOES NOT DEPART: The ship is permanently moored in Vermilion City harbor. It provides free cabin healing and remains accessible for quests and post-gym gifts.
SHEARS CUT TOOL: Obtained in Route 2 Before Forest via Diglett's Cave from Vermilion City. Do NOT use HM01 Cut slave.
TELEPORT FIELD MOVE: Acts as Fly to fast-travel to any visited Pokémon Center once the Thunder Badge is obtained.

critical_missables.title: Building Materials
critical_missables.consequence: Deliver the materials before beating the Elite Four to receive the Rocky Helmet.

active_and_ongoing_quests.title: The Lumberjack! (Shears Acquisition)
objectives: Enter Diglett's Cave from Route 11 / Vermilion City in Chapter 3.
Exit onto the isolated eastern portion of Route 2.
Enter the house surrounded by cuttable trees and accept the quest from the elderly man.
Go into the backyard and interact with every small tree to cut them all down.
Speak to the man to claim your Lemonade, +1 Karma, and the Shears!

active_and_ongoing_quests.title: Building Materials
objectives: Speak to the construction foreman in Vermilion City.
Retrieve wooden planks from Viridian City and bricks from Pewter City.
Deliver the materials before beating the Elite Four to receive the Rocky Helmet.

authoring_guidance.splicing_safety: Explicitly state: HEAD species, BODY species, and WHICH ability to select at the DNA Splicer prompt.
authoring_guidance.unfuse_safety: Unfusing at Pokémon Mart costs $300. Check move retention before unfusing.
authoring_guidance.gym_duel_rule: Strict 3v3 party limit! Instruct player to deposit extra party members in the PC before entering gym arena.
authoring_guidance.time_of_day: Provide Day/Night alternative suggestions so players are never blocked by real-time spawn windows.
authoring_guidance.stone_evolutions: Advisory: Do NOT use evolution stones prematurely on stone-evolvers (e.g. Nidorino) before key level-up moves are learned.
authoring_guidance.undercover_informant_rocket: Guide player to join Team Rocket for disguises/missions, BUT report crimes to police officer for +10 Karma and Diancie unlock!
